title: release(ci): add CI artifact signing, SBOM/provenance generation and release-manifests for private-installer
author: Ava Morgan
description: Motivation: Private installer releases need end-to-end provenance and verifiable artifacts for regulated customers. This PR wires cosign-based signing, Syft SBOM generation, Syft provenance metadata, and a release-manifests pipeline into the existing private-installer CI so published artifacts (OCI images, Helm charts, and tarball releases) are signed and accompanied by SBOMs and provenance metadata. Changes include new GH Actions workflows for build+sign+publish, a release-manifests generator + template, Helm chart packaging hooks, and small Terraform/installer tweaks to consume manifest data. Checklist: 1) Add GH Actions workflow to build artifacts and produce SBOMs/provenance | 2) Integrate cosign signing and upload signatures to GCS/OCI registry | 3) Produce a release-manifests JSON/YAML bundle with hashes, signatures, SBOM links, and provenance URIs | 4) Update chart.yaml and packaging script to include provenance labels | 5) Add tests and e2e smoke-run for installer upgrades using generated manifests | 6) Document release/process in RELEASES.md. Implementation notes: - Uses cosign v2.2+ for signing and verification. Key material is read from repo secrets during CI; an entrypoint for using KMS/HSM-backed signing is included in the workflow. - Uses Syft (v0.70+) to produce SPDX and CycloneDX SBOMs; syft outputs are stored in the release bucket and referenced from release-manifests. - Adds a small manifest generator (go program invoked in CI) that collates artifact digests, SBOM links, cosign signatures, and signed provenance metadata into a single release-manifests/<version>.json. - Helm packaging step now attaches provenance labels and stores chart packages in the registry with signed index entries. - Terraform module changes are limited: output the installer-ARTIFACTS manifest location and a new module variable to optionally consume signed manifests for upgrades. Testing: unit tests for manifest generator, local smoke runs of GH Actions via act, and a deploy validation job that performs a dry-run install using the generated manifests to verify chart digests and cosign verification. Rollout: merge to main triggers an authenticated release run (manual_dispatch) that must be invoked by release engineers; automated canary publish is gated behind flags. Related work: ENG-2894, ENG-3012, SEC-482. Risks & mitigations: key leakage risk mitigated by using short-lived keys and KMS; cosign reliance mitigated by adding verification steps in the installer that can fallback to digest-only verification if signing verification fails, with alerting.
commits: feat(ci): add workflows/private-installer-release.yaml - build, sbom, cosign sign and publish
chore(release): add tools/release/manifest-generator main.go and unit tests
feat(helm): package charts/private-installer with provenance labels
chore(terraform): expose artifact_manifest_url output for module upgrades
docs: update RELEASES.md with signing and verification steps
review_comments: Samir Patel (reviewer): Can we avoid storing private keys in repo secrets long-term? Suggest adding KMS/HSM instructions and a 'key-unwrap' flow for maintainers.
Author (Ava Morgan) reply: Agreed. The workflow already supports KMS-backed cosign via the 'COSIGN_KMS' env flag; I'll add documentation and a sample key-rotation script to RELEASES.md.
Lina Chen (reviewer): CI run failed on first attempt due to flaky e2e smoke job (network timeout). Recommend adding retry and increasing timeouts for registry pulls.
Author reply: Increased timeout and added 3x retry to the smoke job. Re-ran CI and smoke passed.
Jordan Lee (security): Please include SBOM attestation in the manifest and ensure predicates include build env + syft version.
Author reply: SBOMs now include syft version and a build env label; attestation predicate included in manifest under provenance.attestations.
Approver (Maya Rivera): LGTM after the KMS docs and retry fixes. Verified verification binary in installer accepts manifest URL and validates cosign signatures. Approved.
CI bot: Build passed; Test suite 1 failed on first run (installer/upgrade/upgrade_runner_test.go), re-run passed. All checks green before merge.
release_notes: Add cosign signing for private-installer artifacts (Helm charts, OCI images, tarballs)
Generate and publish SBOMs (SPDX/CycloneDX) via Syft alongside artifacts
Produce release-manifests/<version>.json containing digests, signatures, SBOM links, and provenance attestations
Expose Terraform module output with artifact_manifest_url to support upgrades referencing signed manifests
Installer verification tool can validate manifests and cosign signatures before performing upgrades
notes: Release is gated: merge to main only enables manual authenticated release_dispatch to run the publish workflow.
Ops: follow RELEASES.md to perform the first signing with KMS-backed keys; rotation instructions included.
Follow-up items: automate manifest promotions to dedicated release buckets and add OCI registry attestation storage (ENG-3120).
